newsitem.title: USA: First Midwest splits stock, raises payout.
newsitem.headline: First Midwest splits stock, raises payout.

text.p: First Midwest Bancorp Inc said Thursday its board had declared a five-for-four stock split and increased the quarterly dividend by 19 percent.
The split is payable December 16, record December 1. Cash will be paid in lieu of fractional shares.

The new quarterly dividend is $0.20 a share on a post-split basis, payable January 21, record December 27. It compares with a previous dividend, before the split of $0.21 a share, or roughly $0.168 on a post-split basis.

"The 25 percent increase in outstanding shares resulting from the stock split should generate wider distribution and improved marketability of our shares, while the significant increase in the cash dividend is consistent with our growth in earnings and future prospects," Robert O'Meara, president, said in a statement.
The board also fixed April 16 as the date of the 1997 annual meeting.
First Midwest, the third largest bank holding company in Illinois, has $3.1 billion in assets.
